description: Usage stats module can record API calls and estimate cost
steps: Call stats.record() with endpoint, method, duration, token_count

description: Usage stats tracks total calls and tokens correctly
steps: Record 5 API calls with 500 tokens each
Verify total_calls equals 5 and total_tokens equals 2500

description: Endpoint stats correctly count success and error responses
steps: Record 2 successful calls and 1 error call
Verify success_count and error_count are correct

description: Session stats returns call count and tokens for a session
steps: Verify call_count equals 2 and total_tokens is correct

description: Cost estimator calculates GPT-4o pricing correctly
steps: Estimate cost for 1M input + 1M output tokens
